summary: Locate kitty-graphics APC sequences without altering the byte stream; stop leaking the outer terminal's identity into panes; stop disowning a daemon whose binary is not named `shux`. The load-bearing claim is that the text/render path is bit-identical to the base commit: vte receives every byte unchanged and only its `advance` calls are cut at APC boundaries. No graphics command is acted on and no graphics query is answered yet.
dootsabha_substitution: dootsabha unavailable in this environment. Per CLAUDE.md's Tooling fallbacks table, replaced by cold-context adversarial agents on disjoint surfaces: two at DESIGN stage (APC handling; protocol semantics + diagnosis), recorded in adversarial-review-apc.md and adversarial-review-protocol.md, and one over the IMPLEMENTATION DIFF, recorded in adversarial-review-implementation.md. An earlier revision pointed `dootsabha_implementation` at the second DESIGN review, which satisfied step 1 twice and step 6 not at all.
method: Rendered 9 workloads through real shux panes on a build of the base commit and on this branch's HEAD, then compared with .claude/automations/pixel_verify.py at exact thresholds (0/0). Each metric carries the two commit SHAs under `provenance`. Workloads: truecolor+indexed+basic colour probes at 80x24 and 120x40; an APC-bearing stream (well-formed kitty graphics, an ESC-aborted APC, an unterminated APC) at both sizes; and replays of all five committed rich-TUI corpus fixtures at the corpus-native 120x36.
harness_corrections: wait-settled was invoked with wrong flags and the error swallowed by `|| true`, so the harness had never settled anything while reporting success. Flags fixed; the call is now unguarded so a settle failure aborts the run.

The pane was sized AFTER the replay started, so a prefix of every stream was parsed at the 80x24 default and reflowed -- btop rendered with 80-column wrapping inside a 120-column frame and vivecaka captured essentially blank. The replay now blocks on a trigger file created only after `pane set-size` returns.
Rich TUIs were replayed at 120x40 while rich-tui/manifest.json declares the recording as 120x36, so the comparison measured reflow. Geometry is now read from the manifest.
Completion was signalled by printing MARKER_DONE into the pane, which overprinted the frame being measured (visible on nvim). It is now signalled out of band via a file.

The combining-mark probe was written as printf '\xNN' under dash, which does not expand it, so it rendered literally. Fixing the escaping alone was not enough: the replacement used a PRECOMPOSED U+00E9, a single scalar that exercises no combining-mark storage. It is now a decomposed `e` + U+0301.

An intermediate revision REMOVED `stty -echo`, claiming the resize race above had been its only cause. That was wrong, and is recorded here because the wrong version was committed. Both bugs are real and independent. Device-query replies (DA1, DECRQM, DSR, OSC 11 -- nvim.raw carries 10, lazygit.raw 5) are echoed into the frame at a position that races the replay. The committed logs are the measurement: echo-determinism-on.txt shows runs=20 distinct=2 (a 19/1 split), echo-determinism-off.txt shows runs=20 distinct=1. The round-5 audit reproduced the shape independently -- echo off 20 runs -> 1 distinct, byte-identical hash to the committed log; echo on 20 runs -> 1 distinct, then a further 40 runs -> 3 distinct with the same minority hash. A single clean run at n=20 is consistent with the 19/1 split, which is exactly why the earlier 3-run sample could not see this.

The harness leaked one daemon per run and could not tell, because `daemon stop` reported success while leaving it alive. Root cause fixed in shux itself; the harness additionally asserts zero leaked daemons, identified by this run's own unique socket path. Note the precise condition: that assertion fires on a base-commit build only when the binary is RENAMED (e.g. copied to shux-BASE-AB for an A/B), because base accepts any executable whose basename is literally `shux`. Run a base build under its own name and it does not fire.
known_limitations: The `wide: 世界` probe renders as tofu in every arm: the bundled raster font has no CJK. Base-identical and outside this diff, but it means that arm proves wide-cell ACCOUNTING, not glyph rendering.
8-bit C1 APC (0x9F) is deliberately unsupported; see the module docs on graphics::apc.

The `combining:` probe proves combining-mark STORAGE, not rendering: the capture is one cell holding `e` + U+0301, but the bundled rasterizer draws the acute in the preceding cell, so the pane reads `combining:´e`. Base-identical and pre-existing, hence out of this diff's scope -- but do not read the arm as proof of combining-mark rendering.

Evidence logs are named `.txt`, not `.log`, on purpose: `.gitignore` carries a bare `*.log` with no negation, so a `.log` name is silently skipped by `git add -A` -- which is exactly how an earlier revision shipped a manifest citing two files that were not in the repository.
code_commit_note: The last commit on this branch that changes product code. The evidence commit carrying this manifest touches no crates/, Makefile or scripts/, so these pixels came from exactly this tree. An earlier revision stamped a SHA read BEFORE the code it described was committed, and the stamp was self-contradicting: the metrics claimed an echo-disabled harness while the named commit's harness had no `stty -echo` in it.
